lesson.robot_big_shapes.title: Friendly Robot from Big Shapes
lesson.robot_big_shapes.summary: Build a friendly robot from one head box, one big body box, chunky limbs and simple round controls, then add color.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.step.head_and_bo: Start with a wide head box and a bigger body box underneath it.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.help.head_and_bo: Keep both boxes near the middle and make the body clearly bigger than the head.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.complete.head_an: Great! Your robot has a strong head and body.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.step.chunky_limb: Add two chunky arms and two sturdy legs with simple boxy shapes.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.help.chunky_limb: Keep the limbs thick and easy to see. They do not need tiny joints.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.complete.chunky_: Nice chunky limbs. Your robot can stand and wave.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.step.friendly_co: Add two round eyes, two body buttons and a small friendly smile.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.help.friendly_co: Use only a few big details so the robot stays simple and clear.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.complete.friendl: Your friendly big-shape robot is complete.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.coloring.body: Choose a color for the robot body.
lesson.robot_big_shapes.coloring.head: Now choose a color for the robot head.
